notes.title: v2 Update: Pedestrians, Visual Enhancements & Fixes
notes.notes:
An exciting v2 update has been released for City Ambulance Car Driving! You can now experience emergency response missions in the city with a more realistic, more detailed and more fluid structure. Many new features and fixes have been added to the game based on player feedback.

v2 Update Notes

 Pedestrian NPC System added: The city is no longer empty! The level of attention during ambulance missions has increased even more thanks to realistic pedestrian traffic.
 Graphics quality has been increased and optimized: Environment details, lighting and texture quality have been improved. More stable and fluid performance has been provided on all devices.
 Camera system has been improved, bugs have been fixed: Problems with interior and exterior camera angles have been fixed. Now there is a clearer view and control while driving.
 General bug fixes have been made based on user feedback: Errors in mission transitions, interface behaviors and driving dynamics have been rearranged with player suggestions.
